notes: The guest enforces ordering and checkpoint links across k=8 chunk manifests. It does not verify child proof cryptography.

chunks.chunk_id: sequential k=8 child chunk id checked by guest
chunks.input_checkpoint_hash: online checkpoint entering the child chunk
chunks.input_target_checkpoint_hash: target checkpoint entering the child chunk
chunks.output_checkpoint_hash: online checkpoint leaving the child chunk
chunks.output_target_checkpoint_hash: target checkpoint leaving the child chunk
chunks.proof_hash: child proof-manifest hash bound by aggregation, not recursively verified proof bytes
chunks.verify_report_hash: externally verified child proof report hash

public_inputs: aggregate boundaries, provenance/config hashes, chunk roots, and honest claim scope
